subject: Air-gapped on-prem install window and clarifications
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thomas <sara@bioflow.ai>
Cc: Lee Park <lee.park@bioflow.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: air-gapped install scope + proposed windows

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the items we need to lock down so we can schedule the on-site install and finalize the SOW: 

1) Deployment mode: BioFlow confirmed preference for Private (air-gapped) on-prem appliance. No outbound network egress permitted from the inference nodes.
2) Hardware inventory: you mentioned 4 x A100-equivalent servers + 1 management node for telemetry (management node will be air-gapped too). Please confirm GPU model and per-node storage.
3) Upgrade/patch process: BioFlow requested offline upgrade workflow (no direct internet). Options we discussed:
   - On-site engineer applies signed upgrade bundle via USB (preferred), or
   - Encrypted bundle shipped and applied by your ops team with remote verification via signed checksum delivered through an allowed control plane (if permitted).
4) Maintenance windows: you asked for a quarterly major upgrade cadence and monthly security patches. Please confirm blackout windows (we need 4 hours for major upgrade per rack).
5) KMS and keys: confirm whether you will provide a local HSM/KMS or want Redwood to supply a customer-managed key envelope.
6) Evidence & docs: you asked for SOC2 + SOW draft. I'm attaching an initial SOW and a short security notes doc.

Next steps / asks:
- Sara: confirm GPU model, preferred install week (options: Apr 19–23 or May 3–7), and whether BioFlow will provide on-site L1 support.
- Once we have dates, I will lock a field engineer and circulate an install runbook and travel ETA.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood_onprem_sow_draft_v1.pdf (SOW draft), BioFlow_Security_Reqs.pdf (notes)
From: Sara Thomas <sara@bioflow.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lee Park <lee.park@bioflow.ai>, IT Ops <it-ops@bioflow.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 16:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: air-gapped install scope + proposed windows

Thanks Jordan — useful summary. A few clarifications below: 

- Hardware: 4 x NVIDIA A100 40GB (2x per rack, 2 racks), management node is a Dell R740xd with 2x Intel Xeon, 256GB RAM. Local storage for models is 8TB per server.
- Install week: May 3–7 works best for our lab ops team. We need the install to happen between 08:00–16:00 local time.
- On-site support: BioFlow will provide two L1 engineers (Chris and Mina) for day-to-day assistance. For firmware-level work we want Redwood engineer present.
- Offline upgrades: we require signed, verifiable bundles. We cannot accept any mechanism that opens outbound connections from the inference VMs. We can permit control-plane-only egress from the management node through a restricted proxy if absolutely needed, but we'd prefer physically transported bundles.
- KMS: We have an on-prem Thales HSM; we'd like Redwood to integrate with it.

I've attached our security checklist (BioFlow_Security_Reqs.pdf). Also please send a short install runbook and an explicit list of rack power/network requirements (PDUs, public IP not required).

Regards,
Sara Thomas
VP, Infrastructure | BioFlow Therapeutics
sara@bioflow.ai

Attachments: BioFlow_Security_Reqs.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Recap: air-gapped install scope + proposed windows

Forwarding Sara's answers — they confirmed A100-40GB (4x) and May 3–7 as preferred install week. Key asks for engineering:

- Offline upgrade flow: Sara says no outbound from inference VMs; management node may have restricted egress.
- KMS: Thales HSM on-prem (they want integration).
- On-site: BioFlow provides 2 L1 engineers; Redwood engineer required for firmware and final validation.

Can you confirm:
1) Do we support signed USB bundles that a field engineer can apply without any outbound connection from the inference nodes?
2) Do we have existing Thales HSM integration docs and a short checklist for their HSM team?
3) Rack power and PDU requirements per rack — can you draft a short one-pager to attach to the SOW?

Thanks — need these by EOD Wed so I can finalize the SOW and confirm engineer availability.

-J

On Mon, Mar 30, 2026 at 04:37 PM Sara Thomas <sara@bioflow.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Jordan — useful summary. A few clarifications below: ...
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Recap: air-gapped install scope + proposed windows

Jordan / Monica — short answers and next steps from infra/field-eng: 

1) Signed USB bundles: yes — we have a validated process. Field engineer will carry a signed, encrypted bundle (PKI-signed by Redwood) and a verification checklist. It runs entirely locally; no outbound traffic required. We'll provide a verification script that checks signatures and SHA256 before install.

2) Thales HSM: we have a connector we use for customer HSMs (KMIP-compatible). I will attach the HSM integration checklist (short) and the sample config they will need. The integration is performed on the management node; inference nodes talk to the management node over the private LAN.

3) Rack / power / network: per rack we require: 2 x 20A circuits (N+1 preferred), 1U management switch, 1 x dedicated management VLAN with static IPs for the management node and field-sw tools. No public IP required for inference nodes. I'll draft the one-page rack spec and drop it here before EOD.

4) Upgrade windows: Major upgrade (model & infra) will require ~3–4 hours per rack. Security patches (hotfixes) can be applied via scripted USB packages with ~45–60 min per host. We'll include step-by-step MOP in the runbook.

I'll attach the checklists and the proposed install runbook template.

-Marcus
Principal Field Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_field_hsm_checklist.pdf, redwood_offline_upgrade_mop.txt, redwood_rack_spec_sheet.pdf

Subject: Confirming May 3–7 install window + next docs

Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround and Lee for ops support. Confirming what we'll do next: 

- Install week confirmed: May 3–7 (08:00–16:00 local). I will book our field engineer (Marcus) for the week and reserve travel.
- Marcus will circulate: (a) signed USB upgrade MOP, (b) HSM integration checklist, (c) one-page rack and PDU spec. Expect those by EOD today.
- SOW update: I'll add explicit language about offline upgrades (signed bundles), Thales HSM integration, and our proposed blackout windows. I'll send the revised SOW and DocuSign link by end of day Thu.

Could you confirm:
- On-site contact for badging/travel (name and mobile) so we can finalize logistics?
- Any onsite COVID or facility policies we should be aware of?

Appreciate it — I'll follow up with the DocuSign link as soon as I update the SOW.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
